notes:
Seabyss II — Beta 0.1.7-beta.40

- Added double-click attack for valid NPCs, bosses and enemy players.
- Single-click still selects targets without attacking.
- Double-click attacks now use the same server-authoritative combat rules as the Attack button.
- Repositioned the camera zoom control to prevent overlap with the Game Bar.
- Added a dedicated drag handle for moving the zoom control.
- Improved UI and chat protection against accidental world attacks.
